plan.preparation: Verify manifests and the fit-only scaler, freeze all twelve checkpoint/model identities and forty-eight previously calibrated thresholds, then reproduce development logits and historical endpoints exactly. Do not load reserved row IDs, raw shards, staging cache, original validation or test. No training or calibration helper is called.
plan.future_confirmation_data: After explicit authorization only: reconstruct the frozen confirmation row IDs by streaming checksum-verified nested training Parquet shards in the original order, apply the already fitted scaler, and verify counts, ordering, source identity and input-group separation before scoring. Do not trust the unhashed raw-training-staging cache or refit the scaler. Preserve the same 398502 rows and all eight classes.
plan.future_decision_rule: Use the delivered visible model for block128, never the hidden server target. Attack if max attack logit minus benign logit is strictly greater than the stored threshold; ties are benign and attack ties follow canonical class order. No threshold refitting, checkpoint selection, seed dropping, or new training after confirmation opens.
plan.future_assessment: At the primary pre-existing 5% calibration target, apply all five unchanged safeguards to every seed on the same reserved rows. All seeds must pass to confirm the compression claim. A favorable mean or secondary target cannot rescue a failure. Centralized-light gaps are descriptive, not a new equivalence gate. Report actual false-alert differences against each reference; differences above 0.005 are not alarm-matched, including central/FedAvg comparisons even if the inherited five-gate screen passes.
plan.future_reporting: Report all twelve endpoints and all forty-eight operating points, default argmax, confusion matrices, every class precision/recall/F1/support, rare-class correct counts, attack detection versus correct attack-category identification, per-seed paired differences, mean/sample SD/range across training seeds, serialized application payload and synchronization counts. The 5% target was calibrated on development; it is not a guaranteed confirmation or deployment false-alert rate. Secondary targets are descriptive only. No p-value, equivalence or independent-seed-dataset claim.
plan.future_stop_rule: One locked evaluation, followed by synthesis whether the screen passes or fails. If a safeguard fails, report it and narrow the conclusion; do not tune against these outcomes or reinterpret earlier failures as successes. A technical retry may only reproduce the same identities/rules, preserving all partial artifacts and explaining the failure.
plan.limits: The confirmation rows were reserved from fitting/selection for this extension, but originate in previously researched historical training data, not a new collection or capture-session holdout. One non-IID partition and three training seeds. No real network/edge measurement, privacy guarantee, rare-class solution, centralized equivalence or novel-underlying-algorithm claim.
